---
name: Propose a question or source
about: Suggest a new interview question, or a source we have not processed yet.
title: "[Propose] "
labels: propose
---

Same meaning = one card. We rewrite answers — do not paste a course, blog, or another repo.

If you only heard a question in an interview and have no URL, use [Discussions](https://github.com/Borisserz/ios-interview-questions/discussions/new?category=q-a) instead.

**What are you sending?**
- [ ] A specific question
- [ ] A source to process (article, talk, repo)
- [ ] Both

**The question**


**Topic** (Swift / Memory / … or “not sure”)


**Level** (Junior / Mid / Senior or “not sure”)


**Source** (public URL, or where you heard it)


**Notes** (follow-up they asked, optional)
